{
  "#main-content:has(#requests-view:not([hidden])),#main-content:has(#request-detail-view:not([hidden]))": "padding-inline:0",
  "#main-content:has(#request-detail-view:not([hidden]))": "padding-bottom:0",
  "#requests-view": "display:flex; flex-direction:column; min-width:0; min-height:calc(100dvh - var(--nav-height) - 24px); background-color:var(--surface)",
  "#requests-view h1": "font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Noto Sans KR', 'Apple SD Gothic Neo', 'Malgun Gothic', 'Apple Color Emoji', sans-serif; font-size:16px; font-weight:600; line-height:1.5; text-align:center; padding:12px var(--page-inset); margin:0",
  "#requests-empty": "flex:1; display:flex; flex-direction:column; justify-content:center; align-items:center; gap:16px; padding:32px var(--page-inset); min-width:0",
  "#requests-empty h2": "font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Noto Sans KR', 'Apple SD Gothic Neo', 'Malgun Gothic', 'Apple Color Emoji', sans-serif; font-size:18px; font-weight:600; line-height:1.5; text-align:center; word-break:keep-all; overflow-wrap:anywhere",
  "#requests-empty a": "display:inline-flex; justify-content:center; align-items:center; min-height:48px; padding:12px 16px; border:0; border-radius:8px; background-color:var(--action); color:var(--surface); font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Noto Sans KR', 'Apple SD Gothic Neo', 'Malgun Gothic', 'Apple Color Emoji', sans-serif; font-size:16px; font-weight:600; line-height:1.5; text-decoration:none; max-width:100%; word-break:keep-all; overflow-wrap:anywhere",
  "#request-list": "display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr; gap:8px; min-width:0; background-color:var(--quiet)",
  ".request-card": "display:grid; gap:8px; padding:16px var(--page-inset); background-color:var(--surface); min-width:0",
  ".request-card a": "display:flex; flex-direction:row; align-items:center; gap:8px; min-height:44px; min-width:0; text-decoration:none",
  ".request-card h2": "font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Noto Sans KR', 'Apple SD Gothic Neo', 'Malgun Gothic', 'Apple Color Emoji', sans-serif; font-size:18px; font-weight:600; line-height:1.5; flex:1; min-width:0; margin:0; word-break:keep-all; overflow-wrap:anywhere",
  ".request-card a img": "width:20px; height:20px; flex-shrink:0",
  "[data-request-status],[data-request-room]": "font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Noto Sans KR', 'Apple SD Gothic Neo', 'Malgun Gothic', 'Apple Color Emoji', sans-serif; font-size:14px; font-weight:500; line-height:1.5; color:var(--muted); margin:0; min-width:0; word-break:keep-all; overflow-wrap:anywhere",
  "[data-request-trip],#request-detail-trip": "display:flex; flex-direction:row; flex-wrap:wrap; align-items:baseline; column-gap:8px; row-gap:4px; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Noto Sans KR', 'Apple SD Gothic Neo', 'Malgun Gothic', 'Apple Color Emoji', sans-serif; font-size:14px; font-weight:500; line-height:1.5; color:var(--muted); min-width:0",
  ".request-trip-date": "display:inline-block; max-width:100%; white-space:nowrap",
  ".request-trip-meta": "flex-basis:100%; white-space:normal; min-width:0; word-break:keep-all; overflow-wrap:anywhere",
  "[data-request-total]": "font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Noto Sans KR', 'Apple SD Gothic Neo', 'Malgun Gothic', 'Apple Color Emoji', sans-serif; font-size:18px; font-weight:700; line-height:1.5; display:block; color:var(--action); text-align:end; min-width:0; overflow-wrap:anywhere",
  "#requests-error,#request-detail-error": "font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Noto Sans KR', 'Apple SD Gothic Neo', 'Malgun Gothic', 'Apple Color Emoji', sans-serif; font-size:16px; font-weight:500; line-height:1.5; color:var(--error); padding-inline:var(--page-inset); min-width:0; word-break:keep-all; overflow-wrap:anywhere",
  ".request-outcome": "font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Noto Sans KR', 'Apple SD Gothic Neo', 'Malgun Gothic', 'Apple Color Emoji', sans-serif; font-size:22px; font-weight:700; line-height:1.5; background-color:var(--surface); padding:16px var(--page-inset); min-width:0; word-break:keep-all; overflow-wrap:anywhere",
  "#requests-reload,#request-detail-reload": "font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Noto Sans KR', 'Apple SD Gothic Neo', 'Malgun Gothic', 'Apple Color Emoji', sans-serif; font-size:16px; font-weight:600; line-height:1.5; min-height:44px; padding:12px 16px; margin:16px var(--page-inset); border:0; border-radius:8px; background-color:var(--quiet); color:var(--text); word-break:keep-all; overflow-wrap:anywhere"
}
